svg.title: Cutting features is free until the cliff
svg.desc: A test-AUC curve staying flat at 0.979 from two hundred features down to fifty, dipping to 0.97051 at twenty-five and then falling off a red cliff through 0.95181 and 0.90541 to 0.80608 at five features, with the flat part highlighted; below, a crossed-out pair of inference-latency bars showing 1.47 against 1.83 microseconds per row, and a grid of two hundred column squares shrinking to twenty-five with the other 175 swept into a box labelled joins, backfills, monitors and on-call pages.
svg.text: Cutting features is free until the cliff
so where is the win? NOT here:
fewer features was actually SLOWER per row
which selector, and what did it cost?
selection done OUTSIDE the CV, on pure
...and if 99% of your rows are one class? -> M4
